We need answer JSON only. Need produce declaration, implementation, supporting_objects. Need implement FB_Task with exact interface. Need maybe helper DUT? Could just use INT phase internal. Need include VAR_INPUT, VAR_OUTPUT, VAR internal phase/next_phase. Need careful scan semantics: outputs based on next_phase? The spec: at scan, use pre-scan phase q[k], update outputs and next_phase once per scan. P2? P3 says phase=0 & bottleSensor -> Pump_Motor & X(phase=1). So during transition to cleaning, Pump_Motor true in same scan as phase stays pre-scan 0? They reference phase=0 pre-scan? The atomic prop says phase ghost pre-scan state 0...; phase updated once per scan. Formula P3: G((phase=0 & bottleSensor) -> (Pump_Motor & X(phase=1))). Thus output Pump_Motor true in scan where old phase=0 and sensor, and next phase=1. So output should correspond to next_phase, not pre-scan phase. In steady state same. Similarly P4 old phase=1 confirm -> Filling_Valve & X phase=2. So output based on next_phase. Indeed CompleteBehaviorV2 says G(X(phase)=nextPhase), and "Pump_Motor↔nextPhase=1, Filling_Valve↔2, ...". So set outputs from next_phase after transition. Good.

Need one transition at most per scan. If no transition, next_phase = phase, outputs for current phase. But if in IDLE no bottle -> next phase 0 outputs all false. If in CLEANING no confirm -> next=1 Pump true. etc. If COMPLETE no finished -> Completion true. If phase 5 finished -> next=0 outputs all false; if bottleSensor also true same scan? Requirements: "finishedButton resets only completed phase. A bottle still present can start new cleaning cycle on following idle scan." and plan: "A bottle still present after reset can start a new cleaning cycle only on a following IDLE scan, not in same reset scan." Since using pre-scan phase 5 and only check finished, even if bottleSensor true, transition to IDLE not cleaning. Good.

Need decide internal phase variable initialized 0. A fresh instance no execution: outputs default false, phase 0. We can declare phase : INT := 0. next_phase? Could be local temp. We need maybe no supporting objects. JSON object with declaration string, implementation string, supporting_objects empty list.

Need ensure declaration includes all VAR sections. Could use VAR_INPUT (bottleSensor...), VAR_OUTPUT (...), VAR (phase : INT :=0; nextPhase : INT; maybe initialized 0). Need function block name FB_Task. Requirement "declaration is CODESYS FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task followed by all VAR sections; omit END_FUNCTION_BLOCK." So declaration should start "FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task" then VAR_INPUT... etc. No END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. Include maybe no semicolon after FUNCTION_BLOCK? In CODESYS syntax: FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task ... END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. Declaration string typically "FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task\nVAR_INPUT...". Fine.

Implementation: ST body. Need set nextPhase based on phase and inputs. Then set outputs from nextPhase. Then phase := nextPhase. Need careful no multi transitions. CASE phase OF 0: if bottleSensor then nextPhase:=1 else 0; 1: if cleaningConfirmButton then 2 else 1; ... 5: if finishedButton then 0 else 5; ELSE nextPhase := 0; END_CASE. Then map outputs:
Pump_Motor := (nextPhase = 1);
Filling_Valve := (nextPhase = 2);
Capping_Machine := (nextPhase = 3);
Packing_Machine := (nextPhase = 4);
Completion_Light := (nextPhase = 5);
Then phase := nextPhase;

This exactly one-hot. Need consider initial phase default 0. If no prior execution, outputs retained false anyway. After first scan with no bottle, next=0 outputs false phase=0. Good.

Potential issue: In CASE ELSE, if invalid phase reset? nextPhase:=0.

Need maybe include nextPhase initialized 0 in VAR. Good.

Need supporting_objects list maybe [].

Need valid JSON escaping newlines. Return ONLY JSON object. No Markdown.

Let's craft. Need ensure quotes.

"FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task\nVAR_INPUT\n    bottleSensor : BOOL;\n    cleaningConfirmButton : BOOL;\n    fillingConfirmButton : BOOL;\n    cappingConfirmButton : BOOL;\n    packingConfirmButton : BOOL;\n    finishedButton : BOOL;\nEND_VAR\nVAR_OUTPUT\n    Pump_Motor : BOOL;\n    Filling_Valve : BOOL;\n    Capping_Machine : BOOL;\n    Packing_Machine : BOOL;\n    Completion_Light : BOOL;\nEND_VAR\nVAR\n    phase : INT := 0;\n    nextPhase : INT := 0;\nEND_VAR"

Implementation as string.

Need maybe include comments? Fine. But only JSON. Use escaped \n in strings. We can include multi-line in JSON string? Valid JSON requires newline escaped, not literal. We'll write with \n.

Check no END_FUNCTION_BLOCK. Implementation just body.

Let's final.
